title: Molecular Interaction Network Approach (MINA) identifies association of novel candidate disease genes
author: Kara, Hanna, et al.

steps.title: Select seed genes from literature
steps.instruction: Gather disease‑relevant seed genes reported in the literature and compile a list for analysis.

steps.title: Run IPA core analysis and rank networks
steps.instruction: Upload the seed‑gene list to Ingenuity Pathway Analysis (IPA) core tool; run the analysis allowing IPA to search for direct interactions among seed genes and to build networks up to the default maximum of 35 members; obtain score‑ranked networks connecting the seed genes.

steps.title: Select top-ranked network
steps.instruction: From the IPA output, choose the network with the highest score (largest, top‑ranking network) for downstream analysis.

steps.title: Identify candidate genes and SNPs
steps.instruction: Extract all genes that connect the seed genes within the selected network (candidate genes); record each gene’s genomic location and retrieve every genotyped SNP associated with those genes.

steps.title: Validate candidate genes in primary GWAS
steps.instruction: In the primary GWAS dataset, extract the originally corrected genetic association p‑values for each candidate gene; estimate the number of independent SNPs per gene using pairwise LD (D′ ≥ 0.8) based on HapMap and 1000 Genomes data; apply a Bonferroni correction using the count of independent SNPs to all p‑values < 0.05; report the smallest corrected and uncorrected p‑values per gene, the total number of valid genotyped SNPs, and the number of SNPs with p < 0.05.

substeps.instruction: Extract corrected p‑values for each candidate gene.
Estimate independent SNPs per gene using LD (D′ ≥ 0.8) from HapMap/1000 Genomes.
Apply Bonferroni correction based on the number of independent SNPs to all p‑values < 0.05.
Report smallest corrected and uncorrected p‑values, total valid SNPs, and count of SNPs with p < 0.05.

steps.title: Replicate findings in secondary GWAS or case‑control
steps.instruction: Repeat the validation in a secondary GWAS dataset or in a new case‑control cohort; for each gene select the smallest adjusted p‑value and again apply a Bonferroni correction based on the number of independent SNPs genotyped to assess genotype‑phenotype association.

substeps.instruction: Perform the same extraction and LD‑based independent SNP estimation in the secondary dataset.
Apply Bonferroni correction using the independent SNP count.
Select the smallest adjusted p‑value per gene as the replication result.
